title: 建築空間論
subtitle: Theory of Architectural Space
educationalGoal: By learning the concepts and techniques of architectural design and regional planning, using the actual building and cityscape as learning materials, advanced specialization in architectural design, planning and design, architectural structure, construction methods, urban planning and urban design Acquire knowledge. In addition, it is an opportunity to think about the connection between the area and architecture by looking at good architecture in the area
advice: Students will select modern buildings and cities, traditional buildings and cityscapes in Hokuriku, and conduct literature surveys and field surveys. The format of the presentation will be a report with commentary, criticism, drawings, photographs, etc., presentation using audiovisual materials such as PowerPoint, and a Q & A session and comments. The presentation will focus on the location environment and its response, the degree of realization of key functions, design concepts and techniques. Students will have a valuable accumulation of hands-on experience of experiencing architecture and the area, as well as the creation of a collection of published works at the end of class. In addition. Work presentations are based on groups (about 3 or 4 people).
requiredKnowledge: It's a good idea to get into the city and take the habit of taking pictures and sketching on a regular basis. In addition, I need to improve my skills every time I go to society, because I need presentation skills everywhere.

activityGoals.body: You can experience the use, function, beauty, etc. required for architecture and regional planning.
It is possible to observe how buildings and areas respond to public characteristics, landscape, etc.
Able to conduct field surveys and research on materials, create materials and prints, and make presentations
Students can develop their own sense of values and aesthetic sense by presenting their own assignments

achievementLevels.ideal: You can observe the architecture, streets, and cities of the East and West in an interesting way, and further research and study. And the knowledge and sensibility gained from it can be reflected in my design.
achievementLevels.standard: When you go to the city on a regular basis, you can appreciate the architecture and enjoy the city For those who experience and are more interested, remember with photos and sketches Have a habit to keep in mind And I can reflect what I got there in my design
